margo: Heads up — after merge of PR #4321 I'm seeing a consistent SSE tail-latency regression on staging (~150-300ms at p95). Looks correlated with requests that trigger tool_call + KV cache lookup.
raj: ugh. #4321 touched kernel routing heuristics (smart-route-by-cost). Could be batch selection now favoring throughput over latency in some cases. Can you paste a quick repro? :eyes:
li: quick repro I used:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  'https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate?model=redwood-alpha' | ts
```
You can see a ~200ms stall between chunks for requests that call tools.
stefan: I ran a short pprof on the runtime during a repro. Flame shows time in two hotspots: kernel routing decision (call_site: Router::score_candidates) and proto serialization during toolcall handoff (google::protobuf::SerializeToArray). Also a surprising memcpy path from transport coalesce.
ana: CI perf job failed too: `perf-nightly/sse-latency` flagged a +170ms regression on the sse-1000 test after the last rollout. Job link: https://ci/redwood/perf/19456 (ci-bot posted full logs)
ci-bot: perf-nightly/sse-latency failed (baseline vs head: +172ms p95). Artifacts: flamegraphs, packet captures, perf traces.
raj: let's bisect between commits a7f2e3 (pre) and b3c9f1 (post). I suspect the routing patch but also we changed batching heuristics shortly after — need to test both.
margo: can somebody run a quick bisect? If it's the routing change we'll probably revert. If it's batching heuristic we may hotfix to prefer latency for tool_call routes.
stefan: started bisect on staging pool now. Early signal: reverting the routing change locally removes the stall in my microtest. That points to kernel-routing -> batch skew -> bigger batches -> more serialization work per flush (esp. for tool calls which do KV handshake). I can push a temporary revert PR.
raj: temporary mitigation we can try right away: set batcher.max_batch_latency_ms=4 (was 8) and force tool_call routes to be treated as latency-sensitive (`route.priority=latency`) in routing policy. That should reduce batch coalescing for tool calls.
li: confirms lowering max_batch_latency on staging drops p95 back near baseline (~+10ms). Will keep running tests for 30min.
margo: please open a rollback PR so we can cut a hotfix if staging doesn't stabilize. Also add a perf CI job that exercises SSE+tool_call explicitly to catch this next time.
raj: prepping hotfix PR that adjusts routing scoring to include an explicit latency penalty for KV-miss-heavy routes. Patch snippet:
```
if (route.flags & RouteFlag::ToolCall) score += latency_penalty;
```
I'll include a unit test for route scoring.
stefan: once PR is up I can canary to us-west-2a dedicated capacity. If green we can roll to staging and then prod.
ana: noted — I'll pin the perf-nightly job to run after the canary and block the rollout if regression still shows.
margo: plan sounds good. If we don't have a clean canary within 2h I'll open full rollback. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
